title: "spread"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r}
source("spread_pdf.R")

# Single image
create_spread_pdf("spreads/my_photo.jpg", "output/my_photo_spread.pdf")

# All JPGs in a folder
process_folder("spreads/", "output/")

# Batch + combined PDF
process_folder("spreads/", "output/", combine = TRUE,
               combined_name = "bird_book.pdf")

# Custom options
process_folder("photos/", "spreads/", 
               combine = TRUE,
               combined_name = "bird_book.pdf",
               font_size = 36,
               margin = 0.75)
```
